seven_slots.conclusion_metric: sampler's uniform pushforward equals κ at every history; b is measurable; generated prefixes exactly match q; pointwise causality holds; joint measure factors via a measure-kernel composition; conditional kernels agree history-law-a.e.; under the extra ν premises, expected fixed excess equals a nonnegative squared-deviation sum. seven_slots.constants_indices_boundaries: t uses tape coordinates through t and observation coordinates strictly before t. Initial history is empty; initial action is f0 at that history and u0, without a specified numeric value. Actions are feasible by type at all inputs. T0 has zero excess and an empty sum. seven_slots.information_probability: actual prior generated actions feed the recursion. Same f and same path are used for finite prefixes, conditional laws and losses. The tape is independent of the entire exogenous stream, and its fresh uniform u_t drives the new action. Conditional-law equality is AE under the ν,t-dependent history pushforward; every-history sampler representation is a different, stronger pointwise scope. The infimum is outside expectation over both tape and stream, not an expected hindsight minimum.
seven_slots.excluded_scope: no adaptive tape/action-dependent observation law, no single universal null-history set across all ν, no assertion of unique/computable sampler, no regret convergence or zero excess for arbitrary policies, and no proof/compilation evidence. iid_model.finding: For source strict-past learning with independent internal randomness, a complete private random input plus measurable past dependence is the explicit mathematical model, not a performance premise. A044/A045 derive actual policy/current independence; A002/A007/A008 quantify real predictions relative to subordinate seed-past information including ambient AE/eventual versions. A003 realizes supplied behavioral kernels using one family. No additional arbitrary-private-state bridge is required by these pages under this stated model. Do not certify arbitrary extra side information, unspecified protocols or every trim-completion equivalence; stronger claims would require new exact contracts.

after_action_adversary.finding: A049/A033 quantify every bounded realized stream; A040 establishes strict-past prediction. This suffices pathwise for deterministic adversaries observing the current action. No separate IID action-dependent environment theorem is required.

source_reconciliation.finding: A010 refutes the universal ordinary-comparator-limit inference for same bounded actual FTL; A037 characterizes exactly when literal limits hold; A030 retains the necessary convergence premise. Faithful corrected-source reconciliation can record pinned definition, true finite bound, strict counterexample and proposed upper/limsup correction separately. It cannot certify the false inference as proved or alter the source. This is source-mapping authority, not author endorsement or chapter acceptance.

log_lower.finding: Binary paths are a subset of legal interval paths; a fixed binary witness for every causal seeded bounded binary-history rule supplies the qualitative worst-case logarithmic obstruction. Preserve seed expectation/witness order; no exact minimax constant.

general_initialization.finding: A019-A026 supply state/definition/causality, not performance. A033/A034/A039/A041/A049 concern only half. Printed3 family promise requires G1; the source correction changes asymptotic meaning, not its initialization quantifier.
